## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 225 captures during December 2020. Activity proceeded as planned, with session lists maintained apart from routine leave. The recorded activity provides the basis for review of image quality and grading performance for the month. No further operational exception was identified in the information provided.

## Image quality

There were 18 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 8.0 per cent. These results should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance, with attention to any recurring issues affecting the suitability of images for grading. The reported rate and count provide a clear summary of image quality during the reporting period.

## Grading

A total of 36 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 2 days. This indicates that grading activity was completed within the reported median period, while the referable findings should continue through the appropriate follow-up arrangements. Overall, the report records activity, image quality and grading outcomes for Market Eye Clinic in December 2020.
